service.description: The current user's chat preferences with their defaults: enterSends (CHAT_ENTER_SENDS, Y: Enter sends and Shift+Enter is a new line; N: Ctrl+Enter sends), sounds (CHAT_SOUNDS, Y), readReceipts (CHAT_READ_RECEIPTS, Y), typing (CHAT_TYPING, Y: send and show typing), linkPreviews (CHAT_LINK_PREVIEWS, Y: the framework fetches the previews of the links the user sends; N: none), notifyDefault (CHAT_NOTIFY_DEFAULT: all, mentions or none for the rooms the user makes or joins, which the framework's ChatServices start a membership at; empty for the room's own default), notifyPreview (CHAT_NOTIFY_PREVIEW, Y: a mention's notification has the message text; N: only who mentioned the user where, read by the framework's notify#Mention), autoAwayMinutes (CHAT_AUTO_AWAY_MINUTES, 10, which the framework's presence reads), dndFrom and dndTo (CHAT_DND_FROM and CHAT_DND_TO, HH:mm in the user's time zone, apply#DndHours), and statusPresets (CHAT_STATUS_PRESETS, a JSON list of {emoji, text, clearAfter}: minutes, today, week or 0 for never; five presets until the user changes them; the account menu's status dialog, WebrootChat.js, reads the same preference).
Save the chat preferences of ChatSettings (get#ChatPrefs names them); a preference not given stays. The do not disturb hours are both set (HH:mm) or both cleared.

parameter.name: saveFlags
parameter.description: The form has the check boxes, so an empty one is N

service.description: Add a status preset (emoji, text, clearAfter) at the end of the list, or remove the one at index.

Set the current user's status text and emoji from the preset at index (org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.set#UserStatus), clearing after its minutes, at the end of today or of this week (Sunday) in the user's time zone, or never.

Put the current user's default notification level (CHAT_NOTIFY_DEFAULT) on every room the user is in but the direct ones (ChatSettings, Apply to my rooms). Each room on its own: one that fails is logged and the rest go on.

The do not disturb hours (ChatSettings; a ServiceJob every five minutes): a user whose CHAT_DND_FROM and CHAT_DND_TO window, in the user's time zone, holds now and whose status is online is put on do not disturb, noted in CHAT_DND_AUTO; once the window is over a status this put on do not disturb goes back to online (a status the user changed in between stays). A window from 22:00 to 07:00 runs over midnight. Each user on their own (a status in its own transaction): one that fails is logged and the rest go on.

Internal: a room list as the rail shows it, each room with url (its Chat link, under comms_app_root) and, for a record room, record {visible, title, typeLabel, url, icon, entity, id} from the record-lookup providers (lookup#Records info). A record no provider answers for, or the user no longer sees, keeps the room's name.

What the Chat screen and the tray's Chat tab start with: me {userId, username, name, partyId}, the preferences (get#ChatPrefs, with recordLink: an app files messages on its records), the user's rooms (org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.find#Rooms, pinned first, then by the last event, decorate#Rooms) up to limit, and the unread and mention totals.
Rooms as find#Rooms finds them (filter, searchText, includeJoinable for Browse rooms), decorated as the rail shows them.

A room as the room view opens it: the room (org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.get#Room, which refuses a room the user may not read) with displayName and its record (decorate#Rooms), the user's member row and access, the members, and the first page of its timeline (get#TimelinePage: the latest events, or those around aroundSeq).

A page of a room's timeline (org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.get#Timeline: beforeSeq, afterSeq, aroundSeq, a thread by threadRootEventSeq, or pinnedOnly) with userNames, the names of the users its events name (senders, reactions, the users of membership and system events, a thread's last replier, a forward's sender, a poll's voters), so the client words those rows. eventSeq gives that one event.

The @ mention list of a room's composer: the room's members whose name has the term, and in a public room (where anyone may be mentioned) the other users too (org.moqui.comms.CommsServices.search#Users), as [{id (the userId), label}]; the user is left out. First @room (id @room: every member), for a moderator or owner, or anyone in a room of 20 members or fewer, as the framework's send#Message takes it. A room the user may not read answers no one.

A new room (org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.create#Room) from the New room and New direct message dialogs: roomTypeEnumId direct (one room per set of users: the existing one is answered), private or public (a name), with the members of memberUserIdList or the comma list memberUserIds; each member starts at their own default notification level (CHAT_NOTIFY_DEFAULT, which create#Room reads).

The room of a record, for a record's chat link: the record room the user may read (org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.get#Room by the record), or a new one the user makes on first use (create#Room of type record, named after the record as a record-lookup provider names it, which needs the user to see the record: the theme's STRT_RECORD_VISIBLE_SERVICE). A record the user may not see is "not found"; a room of the record kept for its members is refused by create#Room.

Join a room the user may join (a public room, or a record room whose record the user sees: org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.add#Member, which starts the membership at the user's default notification level).

Send a message from the composer (org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.send#Message, as the current user, a member of the room): its body (the m-rich-text light HTML with @ mentions), files uploaded to the room (chatAttachmentIds, comma separated, or chatAttachmentIdList), a reply or a thread, a forward (forwardOfChatRoomId and forwardOfEventSeq: the server makes the quote), and as its records the records its /qapps links name (lookup#Records links). The mention notifications link to the room (roomUrl). clientRef: a send tried again (the page's outbox) is answered with its first message, duplicate true.

actions.script: const ids = Array.from(chatAttachmentIdList || []).concat(chatAttachmentIds ? String(chatAttachmentIds).split(',') : []) .map((id) => String(id || '').trim()).filter((id) => id) const records = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.ChatScreenServices.lookup#Records').parameters({operation: 'links', body: body || ''}).call().recordList const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.send#Message').parameters({chatRoomId: chatRoomId, body: body || null, replyToEventSeq: replyToEventSeq ?? null, threadRootEventSeq: threadRootEventSeq ?? null, chatAttachmentIdList: ids, recordList: records, roomUrl: (System.getProperty('comms_app_root') || '/qapps/BasicComms') + '/Chat?chatRoomId=' + encodeURIComponent(chatRoomId), clientRef: clientRef || null, forwardOfChatRoomId: forwardOfChatRoomId || null, forwardOfEventSeq: forwardOfEventSeq ?? null}).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) return eventSeq = out.eventSeq; event = out.event; clientRef = out.clientRef; duplicate = !!out.duplicate

service.description: Store files for a message about to be sent in a room (org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.upload#Attachment, each in its own transaction): uploadList [{chatAttachmentId, fileName, contentType, fileSize}] and failedList [{fileName, error}]. One file that fails is logged and the others are kept; when none is stored the first error stays.

The palette's Chat rooms group (design §13, the # prefix is the room switcher): the user's rooms and the public ones whose name or topic has the text (org.moqui.impl.ChatServices.find#Rooms), the latest first, or the latest rooms for no text; each a row {title, subtitle, icon, url} to the room. moreUrl is the Chat screen.
